judgment: It is good to set out.
It is good to ford the great river.
image: So the noble one, when he sees good, moves towards it;
and when he has faults, he changes them.
lines: It is good to use this for great work.
Great good, and no harm.
Someone adds to it for him —
a tortoise worth ten strings of cowries — and it cannot be refused.
Holding firm, long: good.
The king offers to the god on high: good.
He is added to by a time of misfortune: no harm.
There is trust as he walks the middle;
he tells the duke, jade tablet in hand.
He walks the middle,
and tells the duke, who follows him.
It is good to use this support
to move the state.
There is trust, and a kindly heart:
do not ask — great good.
There is trust: kindness answers my virtue.
No one adds to it for him;
someone strikes it.
His heart is set up without constancy.
Misfortune.

notes.name_en: 益 is overflow, adding to; 'Adding', paired with 41 Lessening.
notes.L3: 用凶事: gain that comes through another's ill time (relief work, funerals) — 'by a time of misfortune'.
